name: Adrian & Kevin's Action Dashboard — reproduction bundle

components.board/page.html: The complete single-file board page (HTML, CSS, JS). Publish it with the Artifact tool.
components.board/capabilities.json: Runtime capabilities to pass on the first publish (db rules, user, assets).
components.board/data/items.json: 60 action items (i01..i63 with gaps where items were deleted).
components.board/data/meta.json: meta/sweep: last sweep timestamp, note, run log, schedule.
components.board/data/by-id/: The same documents, one JSON file per document, ready for ArtifactData set with file_path.
components.routine/daily-kevin-sweep.json: The 6:45 PM Pacific daily sweep routine: cron, binding, full prompt.
components.playbook/playbook.html: Source of Kevin's Board Playbook PDF (cover with how-it-works diagram + playbook).
components.playbook/how-it-works.svg: The system diagram used on page one and in the Claude Doc.
components.playbook/how-it-works.png: PNG render of the diagram (uploaded to the Claude Doc).
components.playbook/render-pdf.js: Playwright script that renders playbook.html to the PDF with page footers.
components.playbook/email-long-version.html: Earlier full-length email body (superseded by the short email).
components.playbook/email-short.txt: The short 3-step email sent to Kevin.
components.../Kevins-Board-Playbook.pdf: The finished PDF at the repository root.
